name: exists_continuous_eLpNorm_sub_le_of_closed
statement: p ≠ ∞) {s u : Set α} (s_closed : IsClosed s) (u_open : IsOpen u) (hsu : s ⊆ u) (hs : μ s ≠ ∞) (c : E) {ε : ℝ≥0∞} (hε : ε ≠ 0) : ∃ f : α → E, Continuous f ∧ eLpNorm (fun x => f x - s.indicator (fun _y => c) x) p μ ≤ ε ∧ (∀ x, ‖f x‖ ≤ ‖c‖) ∧ Function.support f ⊆ u ∧ MemLp f p μ

name: MemLp.exists_hasCompactSupport_eLpNorm_sub_le
statement: p ≠ ∞) {f : α → E} (hf : MemLp f p μ) {ε : ℝ≥0∞} (hε : ε ≠ 0) : ∃ g : α → E, HasCompactSupport g ∧ eLpNorm (f - g) p μ ≤ ε ∧ Continuous g ∧ MemLp g p μ

statement: ℝ} (hp : 0 < p) {f : α → E} (hf : MemLp f (ENNReal.ofReal p) μ) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) : ∃ g : α → E, HasCompactSupport g ∧ (∫ x, ‖f x - g x‖ ^ p ∂μ) ≤ ε ∧ Continuous g ∧ MemLp g (ENNReal.ofReal p) μ
